title: Costing and mis manager
description:
**Company Description**
Eglo is a lighting solutions company focused on designing and manufacturing contemporary, functional, and energy-efficient lighting products. The company emphasizes innovation and quality, offering a broad range of lighting options for residential and commercial spaces. Eglo aims to enhance everyday environments through well-crafted lighting that balances style and performance. Team members benefit from working in a product-driven organization that values precision, reliability, and long-term customer satisfaction. The company fosters a collaborative work culture with opportunities to contribute to impactful, real-world applications of lighting technology.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for a Costing and MIS Manager located in Bawal. The Costing and MIS Manager will be responsible for preparing, analyzing, and monitoring product costing, variance analysis, and margin reports to support pricing and profitability decisions. The role includes developing and maintaining MIS reports and dashboards to provide timely, accurate information to management for planning and control. The individual will collaborate with finance, production, and IT teams to ensure data integrity, streamline reporting processes, and support budgeting and forecasting activities. Additional responsibilities include identifying cost optimization opportunities, improving internal controls related to data and reporting, and supporting audits and compliance requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial and operational data for decision-making.
* Proficiency in Management Information Systems (MIS), including the design, maintenance, and improvement of reporting structures.
* Knowledge of finance and costing principles, including budgeting, variance analysis, and margin analysis.
* Familiarity with information technology tools and systems used for data management and reporting.
* Experience in data analytics, including working with large datasets, creating dashboards, and generating insights.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications in finance or analytics are an advantage.
* Advanced skills in spreadsheet and reporting software (e.g., Excel, BI tools) and ERP systems.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work on-site in a cross-functional environment.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to present complex information clearly to stakeholders.

title: Inventory Control Executive
description:
We are seeking an Inventory Control Executive to join our team in Haryana. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing inventory levels, ensuring accuracy in stock records, and optimizing inventory processes. This role is crucial for maintaining the efficiency of our supply chain and ensuring that our operations run smoothly. Key Responsibilities: - Monitor and manage inventory levels to meet operational needs. - Conduct regular audits of inventory to ensure accuracy and compliance with company standards. - Collaborate with other departments to forecast inventory needs and adjust stock levels accordingly. - Utilize MIS tools to generate reports and analyze inventory data for decision-making. - Implement best practices in inventory management to reduce waste and improve efficiency. - Assist in the development of inventory control policies and procedures. Required Skills: - Strong understanding of inventory control processes and methodologies. - Proficiency in using MIS systems for inventory management. - Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. - Strong communication skills to liaise with various departments. If you are passionate about inventory management and have the skills to drive efficiency, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Placement Operations & Analytics Intern
description:
**About Newton School of Technology** 




**Newton School of Technology (NST)** 
 is a 4\-year B.Tech program in Computer Science \& AI, founded by IIT alumni, focused on building strong technical skills through hands\-on, industry\-driven learning. NST combines rigorous academics with real\-world projects, coding, problem\-solving, and industry exposure to prepare students for technology careers.
 



 Students get opportunities to work on practical projects, participate in coding and technical challenges, and gain exposure to the technology ecosystem through industry interactions and learning experiences.
 



 For this role, you can then position the internship as an opportunity to work closely with
 **student placement data, analytics, DSA\-driven problem solving, and AI/ML\-oriented insights** 
 within NST's placement ecosystem.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 About the Role
 



 As a
 **Placement Operations \& Analytics Intern** 
 , you will play a key role in supporting the Placement Cell and students throughout the placement process. You will help coordinate interviews and placement drives, manage student communication, track opportunities and outcomes, and use
 **data analysis and problem\-solving skills to provide insights** 
 that help the team make better decisions.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Student Communication \& Scheduling** 



* Communicate placement drive updates, deadlines, eligibility criteria, and interview details to students.
* Address student queries and coordinate with relevant team members when required.
* Coordinate schedules between students, placement coordinators, and recruiters.
* Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts to ensure a smooth placement process.



**Data Analysis \& Dashboard Reporting** 



* Track and analyze placement data such as applications, offer rates, and student drop\-offs.
* Apply
 **DSA and structured problem\-solving techniques** 
 to analyze placement data and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Identify trends and highlight key insights for the placement team.
* Build and maintain dashboards to track placement drives, progress, and outcomes.
* Explore opportunities to use
 **AI/ML techniques** 
 for data\-driven insights, prediction, and process improvement.



**Job Opportunity Tracking** 



* Record and maintain details of new job opportunities received by the Placement Cell.
* Keep opportunity and application statuses updated.
* Ensure relevant opportunities are communicated to eligible students in a timely manner.



**Student Tracking \& Coordination** 



* Track student applications, interview stages, and placement outcomes.
* Follow up with students who may require additional support.
* Coordinate information and feedback between students and placement coordinators.
* Follow through on pending issues until they are resolved.



 Requirements
 


* **Strong understanding of Data Structures \& Algorithms (DSA) and problem\-solving.**
* Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills.
* Comfortable working with
 **Excel and Google Sheets** 
 .
* Basic understanding of
 **AI/ML concepts** 
 is preferred.
* Familiarity with Power BI or Tableau is a plus.
* Knowledge of Google Apps Script is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Ability to manage multiple activities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.



 Qualifications
 


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree.
* **B.Tech / Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Business, HR, or Data\-related fields preferred.**
* Prior experience in data analysis, problem\-solving, coordination, or student\-facing roles is a plus.
